translation.name: Biblica® Wɔnhia ɛho kwamma nwoma Asante Twi Nkwa Asɛm

content: Yei ne Awurade asɛm a ɔde maa Yeremia a ɛfa nsuweɛ ho:

content.text: Mmapɔmma soma wɔn asomfoɔ ma wɔkɔpɛ nsuo;
Wɔde wɔn nsuhina sane ba a hwee nni mu;
ɛfiri sɛ osuo ntɔ wɔ asase no so;
Mpo ɔforotebereɛ a ɔwɔ ɛserɛ so
gya ne ba a wawo no foforɔ
ɛfiri sɛ ɛserɛ biara nni hɔ.
Ɛsrɛ so mfunumu gyinagyina nkokoɔ wesee no so
Ɛwom sɛ yɛn amumuyɛ di adanseɛ tia yɛn deɛ,
nanso Ao Awurade, wo din enti yɛ ho biribi.
yɛn Agyenkwa wɔ amanehunu mmerɛ mu,
adɛn enti na woayɛ sɛ ɔhɔhoɔ wɔ asase no so,
te sɛ ɔkwantuni a ɔsoɛ anadwo pɛ?
Adɛn enti na woayɛ sɛ obi a adeɛ afu ne mu yi,
te sɛ ɔkofoɔ a ɔnni ahoɔden a ɔde boa?
na wo din da yɛn so;

content: Yei ne deɛ Awurade ka fa saa nnipa yi ho:

content.text: Ɛno enti Awurade nnye wɔn nto mu;
na watwe wɔn aso wɔ wɔn bɔne ho.”

content: Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Mmɔ yieyɛ ho mpaeɛ mma saa nnipa yi.
Mmom ɛwom sɛ wɔdi mmuada deɛ, nso merentie wɔn sufrɛ; ɛwom sɛ wɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne aduane afɔdeɛ deɛ, nso merennye. Mmom, mede akofena ɛkɔm ne ɔyaredɔm bɛsɛe wɔn.”
Nanso mekaa sɛ, “Ao, Otumfoɔ Awurade, adiyifoɔ no ka kyerɛ wɔn daa sɛ, ‘Monnhunu akofena na ɛkɔm remma. Nokorɛm mema mo asomdwoeɛ a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa wɔ ha.’ ”

Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Adiyifoɔ no hyɛ nkɔmtorɔ wɔ me din mu. Mensomaa wɔn mennyii wɔn, na menkasa nkyerɛɛ wɔn. Wɔrehyɛ nkɔm afa atorɔ anisoadehunu, nsumansɛm, abosonsom ne wɔn ankasa nnaadaa adwene ho.

Ɛno enti, deɛ Awurade ka fa adiyifoɔ a wɔde me din hyɛ nkɔm no ho nie: mensomaa wɔn nanso wɔka sɛ, ‘Akofena biara anaa ɛkɔm biara remma asase yi so.’ Saa adiyifoɔ no ara bɛtotɔ akofena ano ne ɛkɔm mu.

Na nnipa a wɔhyɛ nkɔm kyerɛ wɔn no, wɔbɛtoto wɔn agu Yerusalem mmɔntene so ɛsiane ɛkɔm ne akofena enti. Wɔrenya obiara nsie wɔn, wɔn yerenom, wɔn mmammarima anaa wɔn mmammaa. Mɛma amanehunu a ɛfata wɔn aba wɔn so.

content.text: “ ‘ma nisuo nnware me anadwo ne awia
ɛfiri sɛ me babaa bunu, me nkurɔfoɔ
Sɛ mekɔ ɔman no mu a,
mehunu nnipa a wɔatotɔ akofena ano;
sɛ mekɔ kuropɔn no mu a
kɔ asase a wɔnnim so so.’ ”
Adɛn enti na wode ɔhaw aba yɛn so
Ao, Awurade, yɛagye yɛn amumuyɛ ato mu
Na wo din enti mmu yɛn animtia;
Kae wo ne yɛn apam no
Na amanaman ahoni ahuhuo no mu bi ma osuo tɔ anaa?
Anaasɛ ewiem bɛtumi ama obosuo apete?
Dabi, ɛyɛ wo, Ao Awurade yɛn Onyankopɔn.
Enti wo so na yɛn ani da,
